description: Reminder: Even when it gets hard, we are still in control #careeradvice #lifebydesign #IntentionalLiving #leadershipdevelopment #SoftLifeMovement
transcript: One thing that I've learned is I am in full control. I have my hands completely on the wheel, and I control the direction that my life goes, and that does not mean that I don't have hardships or trials.
